title: Russia responds after Trump and NATO tell Putin not to 'expand' the war
detail: Moscow issued a response after Donald Trump and NATO warned Vladimir Putin against expanding the war. Reported via a single aggregated headline; details of the Russian response not independently confirmed here.

title: Kyiv claims attacks on a Russian air base and an oil station
detail: Ukraine claimed strikes on a Russian air base and an oil pumping station inside Russia. Claims are Ukrainian and not independently verified; locations and damage were not specified in the headline.

title: Italy angry with Ukraine over strikes on Russian ships off Libya
detail: Al Jazeera reports Italy is angry with Ukraine over its strikes on Russian vessels off Libya, following the Benghazi incident reported Nov 25.
